title: Yangjingzhongyu Decoction regulates primordial follicle initiation via LncRNA-Smad1/AMPK dual pathways in diminished ovarian reserve.
authors: Li, Wanjing; Zhang, Junxin; Shi, Dan; Wang, Jingyi; Luo, Shuting; Yang, Juan; Deng, Disi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过LncRNA-Smad1/AMPK通路调控卵巢储备功能，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Targeting the dysregulated initiation of primordial follicles represents a potential therapeutic breakthrough in managing pathological diminished ovarian reserve (DOR). Previous research has demonstrated that Yangjingzhongyu Decoction (YJZYD) promotes the transition from primordial to primary follicles by post-transcriptionally regulating Smad1 protein via the ovary-specific long non-coding RNA (LncRNA) LTCONS-00011173. This effect may be further supported by YJZYD's ability to ameliorate oxidative stress in the follicular developmental microenvironment through modulation of the AMPK pathway. This study aims to integrate these two mechanistic axes to elucidate the holistic mechanism through which YJZYD modulates the primordial follicle microenvironment. OBJECTIVE: To investigate YJZYD's regulatory mechanism on the primordial follicle initiating microenvironment in DOR rats. RESULTS: In DOR model rats, primordial and growing follicles significantly decreased (p < 0.05), accompanied by reduced E2 and AMH levels (p < 0.05) and elevated FSH (p < 0.05). Treatment with YJZYD-medicated serum increased counts of primordial/growing follicle counts (p < 0.05), with no significant difference between the high-dose group and the control group (p > 0.05). Additionally, YJZYD reduced FSH, increased E2 and AMH (p < 0.05). It also downregulated LTCONS-00011173 and upregulated Smad1 (p < 0.05). Furthermore, YJZYD elevated SOD activity and ATP content (p < 0.05) and reduced MDA levels (p < 0.05). Moreover, it suppressed PTEN expression, dose-dependently regulated MST and AMH (p < 0.05), and enhanced GDF9 expression at low dose (p < 0.05). Molecular docking identified Apigenin and Curcumin as key monomers targeting AMPK/SIRT1/MAPK pathway. Experimental validation of Apigenin replicated YJZYD's effects on follicle numbers and hormone levels (p < 0.01). CONCLUSION: YJZYD alleviates primordial follicle initiation inhibition by targeting the LTCONS-00011173/Smad1 axis, while concurrently improving the follicular microenvironment through AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1alpha mediated oxidative stress repair and energy metabolism enhancement. This dual-pathway mechanism restores follicular factor balance and ovarian reserve function in DOR.
abstract_zh: 背景：靶向失调的原始卵泡启动代表了治疗病理性卵巢储备功能减退（DOR）的潜在突破。既往研究表明，养精种玉汤（YJZYD）通过卵巢特异性长链非编码RNA（LncRNA）LTCONS-00011173对Smad1蛋白进行转录后调控，促进原始卵泡向初级卵泡的转变。这一效应可能进一步得到YJZYD通过调节AMPK通路改善卵泡发育微环境中氧化应激能力的支持。本研究旨在整合这两条机制轴，阐明YJZYD调节原始卵泡微环境的整体机制。目的：探讨YJZYD对DOR大鼠原始卵泡启动微环境的调控机制。结果：在DOR模型大鼠中，原始卵泡和生长卵泡显著减少（p < 0.05），伴随E2和AMH水平降低（p < 0.05）及FSH升高（p < 0.05）。YJZYD含药血清处理增加了原始卵泡/生长卵泡数量（p < 0.05），高剂量组与对照组之间无显著差异（p > 0.05）。此外，YJZYD降低FSH，升高E2和AMH（p < 0.05）。同时，它下调LTCONS-00011173并上调Smad1（p < 0.05）。进一步地，YJZYD提高SOD活性和ATP含量（p < 0.05），并降低MDA水平（p < 0.05）。此外，它抑制PTEN表达，剂量依赖性地调节MST和AMH（p < 0.05），并在低剂量下增强GDF9表达（p < 0.05）。分子对接鉴定出Apigenin和Curcumin为靶向AMPK/SIRT1/MAPK通路的关键单体。Apigenin的实验验证复制了YJZYD对卵泡数量和激素水平的影响（p < 0.01）。结论：YJZYD通过靶向LTCONS-00011173/Smad1轴缓解原始卵泡启动抑制，同时通过AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1alpha介导的氧化应激修复和能量代谢增强改善卵泡微环境。这种双通路机制恢复了DOR中的卵泡因子平衡和卵巢储备功能。
